change: Personalise each workshop PDF with the participant's own scan outcome, company name and trusted company-site logo when available.
root_cause: A workshop PDF could carry the company name but had no explicit reliable rule for company branding, creating a risk of generic, guessed or incorrect logos.
prevention_rule: Workshop reports must be generated from the participant's own answers. Always render the entered company name. Show a client logo only when an asset successfully loads from the explicitly supplied company website or a non-free-mail company domain; otherwise render no logo placeholder and never substitute a third-party guessed brand.
